title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff / regional failover thrashing
author: Asha Patel
description: Hotfix to address observed thrashing between regional failover and SLO enforcer backoff during transient overloads. Symptoms: when a region briefly violates latency-based SLOs, the enforcer concurrently tripped circuit breakers and initiated regional failover. Fast recovery caused upstream load to oscillate and re-trigger failover repeatedly (observed during incident SUP-4421). This PR introduces three safety mechanisms: 1) enforce stronger hysteresis on SLO enforcer backoff windows (configurable defaults increased), 2) add a sampling-based cooldown for regional failover requests to avoid immediate reassignments for short spikes, and 3) improve ordering guarantees in the enforcer to ensure backoff decisions are serialized per-customer to prevent parallel conflicting actions. The change is intentionally minimal and guarded behind feature flags to allow rapid rollback. Checklist: - [x] add hysteresis and unit tests - [x] add sampled cooldown for failover - [x] serialize per-customer enforcer decisions - [x] integration test in perf-canary harness - [x] smoke test in staging - [x] document release notes and config knobs Related: ENG-9734 (slo enforcer stability), ENG-9891 (regional failover throttling).

review_comments: Cameron Lee: Can you explain why we chose sampling-based cooldown vs fixed cooldown? Concern: sampling might allow edge-case rapid failovers for rare customers.

Author (Asha Patel): Sampling allows us to keep average system responsiveness while protecting the control plane; added a follow-up where the sampling bias is configurable per-customer. See controller.go comments.
Miguel Fernandez: The per-customer mutex is good but watch out for deadlocks when combined with existing placement locks. Please add a non-blocking path for high-volume customers.
Author (Asha Patel): Added non-blocking try-lock path and fallback to queueing; included test that simulates concurrent placement + enforcer operations.
Priya Rao: CI flakes observed previously; ensure integration test waits for metric emission before asserting.
merge_commit_message:
hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff and regional failover thrashing

- increase hysteresis windows
- add sampled cooldown to regional failover controller
- serialize per-customer enforcer decisions
- tests and docs
release_notes: Fix: reduce regional failover thrashing by increasing SLO enforcer hysteresis and adding cooldowns; no customer-facing config changes required but tunables exposed behind feature flags for operators.
